certifying_body: CSCMP (Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals)

domain_guidance.summary: Covers primary supply chain management principles and core operational concepts required for modern logistics professionals working within the industry today to understand overarching supply network structures and organizational strategies.

Focuses on demand planning methodologies and techniques used to forecast and manage customer requirements effectively while maintaining accurate alignment between projected market demand and enterprise production capabilities over time.

Addresses supply management and procurement strategies, vendor selection processes, and sourcing practices within organizations seeking to optimize supplier relationships and minimize total acquisition costs across the procurement lifecycle.

Examines manufacturing and service operations, production planning, and operational execution across various enterprise types to ensure efficient creation of goods and delivery of services according to scheduled operational metrics.

Explores inventory management techniques, stock control methods, and policies for optimizing inventory levels while balancing carrying costs against service level requirements across multi-echelon distribution networks and warehouse facilities.

Details transportation operations, modal choices, carrier selection, and distribution network management designed to move products safely and efficiently from point of origin to final destination while minimizing transit expenses.

Covers warehousing operations, facility design, material handling, and storage systems management aimed at maximizing space utilization and improving order processing speed within distribution center environments for operational efficiency.

Focuses on customer service operations, order fulfillment processes, and maintaining service level agreements to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term retention across all commercial distribution channels.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time effectively across the full 240-minute duration carefully to complete all 160 multiple-choice questions during the official testing session successfully without unnecessary stress or rushing.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 160 multiple-choice questions covering eight distinct supply chain management domains, requiring candidates to demonstrate complete knowledge across all tested subjects during the testing session.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Candidates must achieve a passing score of 65% to successfully earn the SCPro Level 1 designation and prove their professional competence in supply chain operations.
The exam has a total duration of 240 minutes, giving all registered candidates adequate time to answer the required questions without rushing through the session.
Candidates are required to have either an SCM degree or four plus years of experience in the field, though additional eligibility requirements may apply for specific applicants.
faq.question_title: What experience is required to take the exam?

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the CSCMP SCPro Level 1 exam covering supply chain management principles, demand planning, procurement, and transport operations.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official exam guides and documentation provided by CSCMP (Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals) to outline competencies, question counts, and duration.

editorial.overview: The CSCMP SCPro Level 1 exam is certified by CSCMP (Council of Supply Chain Management Professionals). It evaluates professional knowledge across eight distinct supply chain management domains including supply chain management principles, demand planning, procurement, manufacturing, inventory management, transportation, warehousing, and customer service operations, designed to test industry competencies completely.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review all eight domain areas carefully and completely before taking the test to ensure success across the board. Focus on core operational concepts such as procurement, inventory management, and transport operations. Complete practice questions to prepare for the 160 multiple-choice questions administered during the 240-minute exam session.
editorial.who_should_take: Supply chain professionals with an SCM degree or 4 plus years of experience looking to validate their knowledge across multiple functional areas of the profession.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: "SCPro™ Level One: Cornerstones of Supply Chain Management is the only industry certification that tests your knowledge of the entire supply chain through one comprehensive exam."
